structures.description: Large two-sided range after the bar-55 spike: swings between the 2358.62 low (bar 80) and the equal 2700 highs (bars 102 and 112), with repeated failed pushes and heavy bar overlap; bar 55 high 2680 anchors the upper resistance zone.

Bull breakout above the 2680-2700 resistance cluster via the bar-114 spike to 2850 (open 2658.81, close 2723.15), with the subsequent pullback holding above the broken boundary (bar 119 low 2716.01, bar 120 low 2722.76).

Bull leg since bar 91: higher lows 2435.71 (bar 91), 2495.82 (bar 97), 2568.16 (bar 108), 2716.01 (bar 119) with higher highs 2585.5 (bar 97), 2643.52 (bar 98), 2700 (bars 102 and 112) and 2850 (bar 114); mid-leg bars overlap heavily and are mostly small-bodied, which is channel-like rather than a fresh spike.

Loose mtr-like top: the bar-55 spike high 2680 was followed by a lower high 2609.02 (bar 75) and then a bear leg to the window low 2358.62 (bar 80); bars 56-74 in between were a choppy range, so this is a loose reversal structure rather than a clean two-legged MTR.
Three-bar pullback from the bar-117 high 2804.59 to the bar-119 low 2716.01 (bars 118-119 are bear bars, closes 2738.87 and 2724.95), still holding above the broken 2700 breakout level.

evidence_for: Sustained higher highs and higher lows since bar 91: lows 2435.71, 2495.82, 2568.16, 2716.01 against highs 2585.5, 2643.52, 2700, 2850.
Strong bull trend bars with large bodies: bar 97 body 71.45 inside an 89.68 range, bar 98 body 56.31 inside a 65.08 range, bar 109 (open 2577.69, close 2611) body 33.31 inside a 39.52 range.
Bull breakout above the 2680-2700 resistance cluster (bar 55 high 2680; bars 102 and 112 equal high 2700) via the bar-114 spike to 2850.
The breakout is being tested rather than immediately rejected: bar 119 low 2716.01 and bar 120 low 2722.76 both hold above 2700.
Window direction is up (2379.79 open to 2740.2 close) and the highest close of the window, 2775.61 (bar 117), came in the most recent swing.
evidence_against: The window is dominated by a two-sided range: 2358.62 (bar 80) to 2700 (bars 102 and 112) covers bars 55-113, and the window high 2850 (bar 114) is still unconfirmed.
The bar-114 spike leaves a 126.85 upper tail and closes at 2723.15, far below its 2850 high, which is compatible with an exhaustion/climax spike rather than a clean trending bar.
No follow-through to a new high after bar 114: bars 115-117 print 2795, 2770.03 and 2804.59, all below 2850, and the two most recent bars (118-119) are bear bars.

Precedent for spike-and-fail in this window: the bar-7 spike (high 2509.15) was reversed by bar 13 (close 2450.96) and the bar-55 spike (high 2680) was followed by the bear leg into 2358.62 (bars 75-80).
Recent bars overlap heavily (bars 108-113 closes 2577.88, 2611, 2631.93, 2642.9, 2664.73, 2658.81), which is channel/range behavior rather than expanding trend behavior.
transition_conditions: Bull confirmation: a close above 2850 (bar 114 high), or a bull bar closing above 2804.59 (bar 117 high) with follow-through, would confirm the bull breakout and spike-and-channel continuation.
Breakout failure: two consecutive closes below 2716.01 (bar 119 low) would signal rejection of the 2700 breakout and shift the read toward a trading range at the window highs.

Possible MTR top: if the 2804.59 high (bar 117) stands as a lower high below 2850 and price then closes below 2568.16 (bar 108 low), a two-legged reversal top becomes the stronger read and the always-in would flip.
Range resolution: continued overlap between 2716.01 and 2804.59 with neither boundary broken would keep the last leg classified as a trading range inside the bull channel.
Deeper pullback: a close below 2435.71 (bar 91 low) would break the higher-low sequence and end the bull-trend classification.
